lines.text: Could we get three pizzas for here?
lines.speaker: Ash

lines.text: Sure. Which ones would you like?
lines.speaker: Lin

lines.text: Two mushroom pizzas and one cheese pizza, please.
lines.speaker: Ash

lines.text: We only have one mushroom pizza left.
lines.speaker: Lin

lines.text: Then one mushroom and two cheese, please.
lines.speaker: Ash

lines.text: Would you like chili oil with those?
lines.speaker: Lin

lines.text: Yes, on the side, please. And two glasses of water.
lines.speaker: Ash

lines.text: Two waters, please. Three pizzas is right.
lines.speaker: Ash
